description.p: Bookx is a native GNOME application for your e-books, written entirely in Rust. It combines a Calibre-style library, a distraction-free reader and a full EPUB editor.

ul.li: Library: covers or table view, tag browser, Calibre-style search, metadata editing, bulk edits, TXT / Markdown / HTML import and export
Reader: two-column pages, single column or scrolling, light / sepia / dark / black themes, highlights, notes, bookmarks, in-book search
Editor: file browser, syntax-highlighted code editor with live preview, find and replace, table-of-contents and spine editing, book checker

description.p: The first beta. It can have bugs, so keep a backup of anything you care about; Bookx can back up your library for you. Reports help us fix bugs: Main Menu, Report a Problem.

ul.li: New: Report a Problem collects a log report you can read, then opens a GitHub issue
Everything in 0.3.0: a bigger library, reader and editor, KOReader sync, backups and read aloud
Not tested on real hardware yet: some e-reader models, sound cards, WebDAV and NAS backups, CBR and DJVU files
Linux (x86_64) only; translations to German, Spanish, French and Hindi are machine-made

description.p: The first public release: a much bigger library, reader and editor, KOReader sync, backups and read aloud.

ul.li: Custom columns, a configurable sidebar, saved searches, Library Health (duplicates, editions, backups, trash) and Move to Trash with Undo
A Devices window for Kobo, Kindle and other e-readers, with the covers of the books on the device and a summary before every sync
Bookx sync for KOReader over Wi-Fi (highlights, notes and bookmarks) and an OPDS server for other apps
Incremental, encrypted backups to a folder, drive, network share or WebDAV, with restore; passwords are kept in the system keyring or an encrypted store
Read aloud with natural offline voices and a player with media keys
Audiobooks with chapters, speed and a sleep timer; a comic reader with two-page, webtoon, smart zoom and right-to-left
Vertical Japanese and Chinese text, a reading ruler, selection handles, more typography settings
A Notes view for all highlights, notes and bookmarks, vocabulary with your own definitions
Syntax-highlighted code editing with live preview, a Problems panel, a command palette, snippets and structure tools
Twelve Preferences pages with one search, a Keyboard Shortcuts page, and an assistant (MCP) page that is read-only by default
Safer by default: links, downloads, archives and plugins are checked, and release files are signed
Translated into Spanish, German, French and Hindi

description.p: Complete rewrite on the latest GTK 4, libadwaita and Relm4: new library, a Rust-only reader and a built-in EPUB editor.

ul.li: Send books to Kobo, Kindle and other e-readers and bring reading progress and notes back
Read aloud with natural offline voices, backups to drives, shares and WebDAV, a command palette
Translated into Spanish, German, French and Hindi (more welcome)
Opens bookx:// links and copies diagnostics for bug reports
